mode: Android ARM64 Profile; platform-default Impeller OpenGLES on STK, Vulkan on OnePlus PLK110

source: Previous is the preexisting row-picture working tree on v0.3.0. A separate historical reference uses 9e60dde.
measure: Native ABBA: 2 cold launches and 8 full pulls per launch per build. 400 logical pixels in 400 ms via Android shell input. Every trial checks the final month and viewport height match. Untraced metrics aggregate all samples including settle; a frame counts once if max(UI,Raster) > 1000000 / refreshHz. P95 uses sorted[floor(0.95*n)].

surfaceFlinger.method: Separate 8 system gestures per build, dumpsys SurfaceFlinger --latency for the benchmark SurfaceView. Count consecutive actual-present timestamp intervals ending within 200 ms of the first new buffer, while the calendar still moves. More than 25 ms is 1.5 vsyncs. These are not Flutter FrameTiming samples.
